title: Uwell Viscore Cherry Ice Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Cherry Ice combines the vibrant sweetness of cherries with a crisp menthol finish, offering a refreshing and flavourful vape. Designed for use with the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack features a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for extended usability and convenience. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod provides smooth vapour and bold flavours, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container makes topping up your pod effortless, delivering up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it a fantastic choice for adult vapers seeking a high-quality and long-lasting vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the crisp, fruity Cherry Ice flavour.
